stem: What is the central idea of the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Jigsaw puzzles started as a way to teach children and are appreciated by people of all ages.

options.label: B
options.text: A mapmaker invented jigsaw puzzles to help children use maps to learn about geography.

options.label: C
options.text: Many people like to work together to put a jigsaw puzzle together.

options.label: D
options.text: Some jigsaw puzzles are easier to put together than others.
